articles.summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP) (“KNOP” or the “Partnership”) advises that its 2026 Annual Meeting will be held on December 22, 2026. The record date for voting at the Annual Meeting is set to November 27, 2026. The notice, agenda and associated material will be distributed prior to the meeting. The 2026 Annual Meeting will be held at Floor 19, 1 Cabot Square, Canary Wharf, London E14 4QJ, United Kingdom at 2:00 pm UK time. Additionally, the Board of Directors of KNOP (the “Board”) announces its nomination of Ms. Pernille Østensjø and Mr. Hans Petter Aas to serve as Independent Directors of the Board, subject to votes by the Partnership’s unitholders at the Annual Meeting. Pernille Østensjø has extensive experience in the shipping and offshore energy sectors in corporate, institutional investment, banking, finance, audit, and government entities, including senior leadership and Board roles. articles.summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP (NYSE:KNOP) (“ the Partnership”) plans to release its financial results for the 3 rd Quarter of 2026 prior to opening of the market on Friday, December 4, 2026. The Partnership also plans to host a conference call on Friday, December 4, 2026, at 9:30 AM (Eastern Time) to discuss the results for the 3 rd Quarter of 2026. All unitholders and interested parties are invited to join via the live webcast link on the Partnership’s website: www.knotoffshorepartners.com . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same link following the conclusion of the live call. Our 3 rd Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation will also be available at www.knotoffshorepartners.com prior to the conference call start time. About KNOT Offshore Partners LP KNOT Offshore Partners LP owns, operates and acquires shuttle tankers primarily under long-term charters in the offshore oil production regions of Brazil and the North Sea.
